text: S10 is for moms. Tiny screen, tiny battery life. Luckily some bloatware can be uninstalled via adb, even without root. Search xda for details. Battery life - 1 day, need to charge nightly. Compared to my other Samsung A70 with its 6.7" screen and 3 day battery life - abysmal.

Longer battery life!. I like my Galaxy S10. Have not used the fingerprint reader or face recognition but the longer battery life is a big bonus. The clarity of the screen is marvelous, it is comfortable to hold and use. I really like it.
S10. I like the phone it needs more battery life but I won't complain

Battery life is terrible.. Very poor battery life. I've bought another S10 renewed and it didn't have this massive battery drain. It only lasts a couple of hours, even if you're not actively using it.

No bueno.. Although we did receive the s10, the battery life was terrible. It came charged at 75%, within a couple hours it was dead and would take almost a full week plugged in to charge to 100%. We were not offered a replacement, however, the phone was sent back and we were given a full refund.
